result.rationale: Quinbrook identifies Primergy as its 100%-owned manager-level portfolio company and Prairie Mist as a project beneath it. The standalone Prairie Mist record is therefore consolidated into Primergy while preserving its 2021 entry, 2023 financing, December 18, 2024 operating milestone, aliases, and sources.

evidence.purpose: Official evidence that Primergy is the portfolio company and Prairie Mist is its project
Official Prairie Mist project status, 2021 acquisition year, capacity, and operating date
Official November 2023 financing confirmation and non-sponsor capital roles
